protocol.license: MIT in dataset publisher README; raw images remain external cache, no image redistribution
protocol.catalog_rule: first N-1 test images, plus one query row; no fitting or threshold changes
protocol.identity_labels: same test index only; different images of same class are hard negatives; possible unknown natural duplicates not manually adjudicated
protocol.positive_generation: scripts/fixtures.py applied after bilinear upsampling native 28x28 grayscale to 224x224 RGB
protocol.separation: new Zalando source family, no scikit-image calibration images; ImageNet pretraining identity overlap not auditable
